decisions.failure: Indexing value["startingVersion"] maps an absent member to Value::Null, so a structurally incomplete success value is accepted as explicit absence of a prior version.
decisions.scope_limit: The actual native producer already includes startingVersion, and the Gateway/transport contracts require explicit presence. No observed native write, CAS bypass or physical publication failure is asserted.
decisions.rationale: A shared success validator must preserve the distinction between a present nullable version and missing metadata; later consumers must not infer an acknowledged baseline from omission.
decisions.fix: Require value.get("startingVersion") to be present and either null or a 64-hex digest. Add explicit-null and valid-digest controls plus missing/malformed negative cases in the existing native receipt contract.
decisions.retained_evidence: Existing source review and fixed source identities remain historical; no candidate runtime acceptance exists.
decisions.invalidated_evidence: Any inference that upload-start success validation already rejects absent startingVersion is invalid.

decisions.failure: The public upload_file(None, ...) route previously delegated optional scope to the existing permission owner. Always permits it; Never and unapproved Ask refuse it. The candidate rejects missing agent before that gate, removing supported convenience behavior.
decisions.rationale: Retain current capability while keeping real agent/toolCallId mandatory at registered/scoped entry. Optional identity already exists in the operation record; no invented agent or second permission authority is needed.
decisions.fix: Use one private upload implementation and the same durable owner. Unscoped convenience may generate only a standalone invocation ID and preserve optional agent, including None. Scoped upload still requires real nonempty agent/toolCallId. Preserve current permission, shared capacity, correlation, uncertainty and restart protection. Permit explicit null agentId for durable anonymous records; require v4 file records to carry the agentId member and reject malformed or empty present values. Agent-scoped status/history/cancel must never match anonymous records.
required_oracles: real Always permits anonymous upload and records agentId:null
Never/Ask refuse anonymous calls before a new frame
scoped missing agent/toolCallId refuses without fallback
anonymous unknown custody and metadata survive restart/shared capacity
agent-scoped status/history/cancel do not expose or mutate anonymous records
v4 missing agentId rejected; explicit null and nonempty identity remain distinct valid states
